name: risk.sla

list.description: Read complete native SLA configuration records.

get.description: Read one native root detail online without changing a saved List.

lookup.name: slaConfigId
lookup.description: Native lookup sent as slaConfigId; use the unprojected List slaConfigId value.

result_identity.description: Native detail slaConfigId; exact nonempty string echo of the requested lookup.

purpose: Inspect native risk sla through bounded inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: slaConfigId
fields.meaning: Native nonempty record identity retained without conversion.

identity_description: Native slaConfigId identifies rows within this leaf and acquisition scope.
limitations: Inquiry-only native JSON and unknown nested fields are retained without projection. Native zero values remain unchanged.

Widths are based on historical successful requests, not measured backend maxima. SDK quality reports duplicate identities, count shortfall and page gaps; strict refresh publishes complete acquisitions only.
Conflicts keep the last arrival and remain incomplete. Rejected refresh preserves the prior saved capture.
One POST with only rowStart=0 and pageSize=5000. List sends no tenant/filter keys and has no offset fallback or detail enrichment.
Native totalCount and native string slaConfigId establish observed List coverage. Source version remains a separate native string.
Native Get uses POST form /api/risk/sla/slaConfigDetailQuery.json; lookup slaConfigId returns one native root object with slaConfigId.
Get preserves all native nested fields and unknown values; separately queried history, logs and child endpoints remain unqueried.
Get is live-only and publishes no cache or Duckdog data.

List --live --with-detail fetches native Detail only for the selected offset/limit window, returns separate record/detail members and fails atomically on any detail error; saved List data remains unchanged.

examples.title: Read one selected List row with its native detail

sync.evidence: Native slaConfigId identifies rows within this leaf and acquisition scope. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
